name: Heimdell Tech Ai Assistant
description: Answers questions about Heimdell Tech Ai Ltd, a UK software development and IT consultancy (Preston, Lancashire) that helps businesses get ready for AI agents (A2A, AP2, UCP, MCP and Knowledge Catalog), covering services, pricing, service areas, expertise and policies. The AI agent readiness review, UCP, Knowledge Catalog, A2A, AP2, MCP and systems architecture are a custom quote. The agent-readiness scan is free. Heimdell TPV (third-party verification) and telecom compliance guides now live at https://telecomcompliance.uk/. Provides on-site Business Technology MOTs in Preston/Lancashire (introductory £99; standard Essential £149, Plus £249, Premium £349), authorised IT repairs from £65/hour plus parts and monthly IT maintenance from £79/month with agreed exclusions. Booking enquiries: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/business-technology-mot.html#booking. Also covers separate AI systems audits, cyber security assessments and staff cyber security training.
